description: This file contains utility functions and classes for tensor indexing operations in PyTorch, including tensor expansion, type checking, transposing indices, and advanced indexing structures.

classes.name: AdvancedIndex
classes.description: Represents advanced indexing information for a tensor, including source tensor, indices, sizes, strides, and dimension offsets.

methods.name: invalid_mask
methods.description: Checks if the mask tensor shape matches the tensor being indexed, throws an error if not.

methods.name: expandTensors
methods.description: Expands Byte or Bool tensors into Long tensors for indexing, replacing masks with non-zero indices.

methods.name: checkIndexTensorTypes
methods.description: Verifies that index tensors are of valid types (long, byte, bool, int if allowed).

methods.name: toListOfOptionalTensors
methods.description: Converts a list of tensors or IValues to a list of optional tensors.

methods.name: hasContiguousSubspace
methods.description: Checks if all non-null tensors in a list are contiguous.

methods.name: transposeToFront
methods.description: Reorders tensor and indices so that all non-null indices are in the front dimensions.

methods.name: transposeToFrontAndInvPerm
methods.description: Reorders tensor and indices, returning the permutation inverse for restoring original order.
